rubric_items.deep_module: pass — each new module hides substantial behaviour behind one entry point: selene_deck.py parses three deck grammars into five IDS netCDF, tokamap_export.py collapses unit×sign×COCOS into a validated directory, eddb_remote.py runs one batch in one remote process, and the §7 EQDB reader reuses the §3 transport and cache rather than adding a path.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the plan routes every shared concern to its existing owner: `JT60SA_ROOT` declared in imas_ambix/data/paths.py:33 beside `MIRROR_ROOT`, shot ranges and pulse identity to the catalogue and `signal_map.load_packaged_signal_map`, description store addressing to `transform_engine.StoreEngine.open`, geometry publication to `gs/artifact_resolution.py`, shot→machine to `spine_bench/shots.py`, and the SELENE comparator to `eval/efit_referee.py` `judge_geometry`; the one cross-repo duplication (§3's own ssh extractor beside codex's remote layer) is named and declined with the locked reason that codex must not become a runtime dependency of an ambix read, which the map-persistence decision fixes.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that adds surface states in its own text what it retires or why nothing can be (§2 exporter "retires nothing, because ambix has no exporter"; §3 "adds no `ambix data` command", "retires nothing, because ambix has no remote reader today"; §4 "widens one protocol method and retires nothing", the probe-angle key "retires the machine branch"; §4/§7 "adds two record fields and retires nothing, because no scalar reference comparison exists yet").
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched both codebases it names: §1 enumerates codex's EDAS scanner, wiki adapters and LLM pipeline, §3 cites codex's `imas_codex/remote/scripts/enumerate_edas.py`, `executor.py`, `ssh_worker.py` and `serialization.py` as the remote layer it declines to import, and §2 cites tokamap/libtokamap; every ambix mechanism it proposes reuses is named with its file and verified present (paths.py `MIRROR_ROOT`, transform_engine `StoreEngine`/`NetCDFTransformEngine`, description_reader `read_geometry_table`, cocos_convention `score_convention`, challenge/loader `load_shot`, artifact_resolution pins, machine_selection `ArtifactMachineSelector`, spine_bench/shots `resolve_shotset_version`, eval/efit_referee `judge_geometry`).
